hooks.commandWindows: $bash = Get-Command git.exe -All -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { $dir = Split-Path $_.Source -Parent; while ($dir) { $candidate = Join-Path $dir 'bin\bash.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { $candidate; break }; $parent = Split-Path $dir -Parent; if ($parent -eq $dir) { break }; $dir = $parent } } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $bash) { throw 'Git Bash not found near git.exe on PATH' }; & $bash "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/wiki_stale_check.sh" codex
